_doc: THE label taxonomy. Format '<prefix>: <value>'. Edit this file, then run .github/scripts/sync-labels.sh. Board fields (Status/Priority/Size/Area) take their options from here via setup-project-board.sh. Naming rules: see the conventions document.

flag.meaning: a condition that sits beside the status

labels.name: type: epic
labels.description: Container for a phase or large area; its children are sub-issues

labels.name: type: feature
labels.description: New user-facing capability

labels.name: type: task
labels.description: A discrete unit of implementation work

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: Something is broken or behaves incorrectly

labels.name: type: investigation
labels.description: Reproduce, measure and attribute before any fix

labels.name: type: refactor
labels.description: Restructure without changing behaviour

labels.name: type: perf
labels.description: Performance, memory or cost work

labels.name: type: test
labels.description: Test coverage or test infrastructure

labels.name: type: docs
labels.description: Documentation only

labels.name: type: chore
labels.description: Tooling, dependencies, housekeeping

labels.name: type: dev-review
labels.description: A check only the developer can run (device, deploy, hands-on verification)

labels.name: type: spike
labels.description: Time-boxed research; the output is a decision, not code

labels.name: priority: critical
labels.description: Blocks release or breaks the product

labels.name: priority: high
labels.description: Do next

labels.name: priority: medium
labels.description: Normal queue

labels.name: priority: low
labels.description: Nice to have

labels.name: status: backlog
labels.description: Board column: filed and classified, not scheduled

labels.name: status: ready
labels.description: Board column: scoped, unblocked, next up

labels.name: status: in-progress
labels.description: Board column: being worked on now

labels.name: status: in-review
labels.description: Board column: pull request open

labels.name: status: awaiting-verification
labels.description: Board column: merged, needs a human check outside CI before it closes

labels.name: status: done
labels.description: Board column: confirmed complete

labels.name: size: XS
labels.description: Under an hour

labels.name: size: S
labels.description: 1-4 hours

labels.name: size: M
labels.description: Half a day to a day

labels.name: size: L
labels.description: 2-4 days

labels.name: size: XL
labels.description: Over a week; split into an epic

labels.name: flag: review
labels.description: New, not yet reviewed (applied by the issue forms); remove once reviewed

labels.name: flag: blocked
labels.description: Has an OPEN blocking issue; mirrored from the Relationships section by the sync

labels.name: flag: needs-info
labels.description: Needs clarification before work can start

labels.name: flag: duplicate
labels.description: Already tracked by another issue

labels.name: flag: wontfix
labels.description: Deliberately not being worked on

labels.name: flag: good-first-issue
labels.description: Small, well-scoped, safe for a newcomer

labels.name: area: editor
labels.description: Monaco editor, autosave, drafts, version save and restore (src/features/editor)

labels.name: area: workspace
labels.description: Folders, document list, tabs, panels, client caches and stores

labels.name: area: backend
labels.description: Server actions and server-side libraries (features/*/actions.ts, src/lib)

labels.name: area: auth
labels.description: Supabase Auth, sign-in/up/out, session handling, middleware

labels.name: area: database
labels.description: Prisma schema, migrations, queries, RLS policies

labels.name: area: security
labels.description: Tenant isolation, headers/CSP, rate limiting, secrets

labels.name: area: ui
labels.description: Shared components, styling and theming (components/ui, Tailwind)

labels.name: area: infra
labels.description: Docker stack, Vercel deployment, environment configuration

labels.name: area: ci
labels.description: GitHub Actions, repository tooling and scripts

labels.name: area: tests
labels.description: Vitest unit/integration suites and end-to-end tests

labels.name: area: docs
labels.description: Rules, PRPs, guides, README

labels.name: area: perf
labels.description: Load time, payload size, query cost
